quarterly_data.quarter: Kepler Communications press release: Kepler Deploys First Space-Based, Scalable Cloud (03-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Kepler commissioned distributed on-orbit computing across its Tranche 1 optical data relay constellation (which Kepler calls the world's first commercially operational optical data relay network); the GPU-enabled platform supports multiple customers concurrently with isolated workloads, for on-orbit data centers, sensing and real-time alerting.
